name: 塔罗牌查询与抽牌
description: 离线查询 78 张塔罗牌，按种子复现不放回抽牌，并生成六种牌阵；用于反思、写作与娱乐。

display_description.en: Offline card lookup, seeded draws and six reflective spreads.
display_description.zh: 离线查询牌义、按种子抽牌并生成六种反思牌阵。

display_description.en: Offline 78-card tarot lookup, reproducible draws without replacement and six reflective spreads, with a native Python host tool and no network calls.
display_description.zh: 离线查询 78 张塔罗牌，按种子复现不放回抽牌，并生成六种牌阵；用于反思、写作与娱乐。

default_init_input.zh: 使用塔罗牌工具抽取三张不重复的牌，关闭逆位，并说明牌义只用于反思。
default_init_input.en: Draw three unique cards with reversals disabled for reflection.
